overview_description.description:
Submittable offers grant management and CSR software tools to help organizations manage social good projects and enhance their influence in their communities. The company’s services are used by organizations to manage grants, awards, fellowships, and other forms of intake. 

Submittable offers a range of core features designed to enhance the management of submissions and reviews. Its submission management system centralizes the collection and organization of applications, proposals, and other documents, simplifying the handling process. The platform includes customizable workflows, allowing organizations to tailor their review and decision-making processes to meet specific needs. Team collaboration is facilitated through features such as shared review panels, comments, and task assignments. Additionally, Submittable provides robust analytics and reporting tools that offer insights into metrics and impact, enabling data-driven decisions. The platform also supports integration with various systems and tools, including CRM systems and email platforms, to streamline overall workflows.
